failure_summary.description: A date range (or depart/return pair) was written as ONE search_flights call using return_date= or return_flights=departure_date. This raised a NameError or ValidationError and dropped the second leg. In one case the hotel in the same turn was also dropped.

'AZ' and 'GA' were passed as city= (one even became the TOOL CONFIG example city 'Dallas'). 'halal restaurant' became cuisine=['Halal'] instead of has_halal_options=True and was left unassigned and unsaved.

A flight budget reply with departure_flights and return_flights both cached filtered only the departure leg. The 'exactly three lines' template in the search gate seems to anchor the agent on one triple.

'Yes, that would be great' to an offer of hotels near the cached attractions was handled as a filter with no kwarg. The agent re-saved the attractions entry unchanged instead of calling search_nearest(groupBy='hotel').

departure_time was passed as ['00:00:00','04:39:00'], which raises 'Unrecognized time format'. The agent also loaded the raw departure_flights key instead of filtered_departure_flights and re-passed the already-applied class.

patch.reasoning: The failures are mostly hygiene errors that already have rules, and those rules are buried deep in the document. I do not add a new gate. Instead I patch four places the agent actually reads. (1) The date-answer item (-2) fires on exactly the failing turns, so I replace its vague flight sentence with a literal two-search template. This also keeps the hotel in the same block and forbids return_date and return_flights. (2) I rewrite the existing 'use only kwargs' hard-rule bullet in place so it carries three corrections: two-letter codes go in state= and never in a TOOL CONFIG example city, dietary words are boolean flags, and no return_ kwargs. (3) I extend the SEARCH GATE sentence the agent obeyed ('Yes' means filter, 'write exactly three lines'). It now says a flight reply gets one triple per flight key and that a 'Yes' to hotels near cached attractions means search_nearest. (4) I add 12-hour time strings and the most-refined-key reminder to the flight-reply item, replacing the single misleading example. Each edit changes text the agent already follows instead of adding a new section.

edits.target: Flight requested: outbound `departure_date=["<X>"]` saved as "flights" and return `departure_date=["<Y>"]` with the cities swapped saved as "return_flights" (each assigned and saved).
edits.content: Flight requested and the user gave two dates ('X to Y', 'depart X and return Y', also inside a first or compound turn with a hotel): write exactly TWO searches, `departure_flights = search_flights(start_airport_city="<origin>", end_airport_city="<dest>", departure_date=["<X>"])`, `save_to_cache(key="departure_flights", value=departure_flights)`, `return_flights = search_flights(start_airport_city="<dest>", end_airport_city="<origin>", departure_date=["<Y>"])`, `save_to_cache(key="return_flights", value=return_flights)`. A `return_date=` or `return_flights=` kwarg, or any variable not defined in the block, is wrong. If a hotel is also requested, the same block continues with `hotels = search_hotels(city="<dest>", checkin_date=["<X>"], checkout_date=["<Y>"], <'3 rooms' -> num_rooms=3, amenity words via the Rule 27 table, stated party size>)` + `save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)`.

edits.target: Use only kwargs listed in TOOL CONFIG. search_flights has NO return_date: a round trip is two search_flights calls.
edits.content: Use only kwargs listed in TOOL CONFIG. search_flights has NO return_date and NO return_flights kwarg: a round trip is two search_flights calls (see item -2). 'AZ', 'GA', 'NV' and every other two-letter code is `state=`, never `city=`; never use a TOOL CONFIG example city (Dallas, Boston...) that the user did not say. Restaurant dietary words are boolean flags, never cuisines: halal -> `has_halal_options=True`, kosher -> `has_kosher_options=True`, vegan -> `has_vegan_options=True`, vegetarian -> `has_vegetarian_options=True`, gluten-free -> `has_gluten_free_options=True`, nut / dairy / shellfish / tomato allergy -> `has_nut_allergy_options` / `has_dairy_allergy_options` / `has_shell_fish_allergy_options` / `has_tomato_allergy_options`; `cuisine=` only for a real cuisine name ('Persian'). 'a halal restaurant in St. Louis' -> `restaurants = search_restaurants(city="St. Louis", has_halal_options=True)` then `save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants)`.

edits.target: A search_* call is allowed only for a domain with NO key.
edits.content: Two replies are NOT a single filter triple: (a) a flight class / airline / time / price-cap reply gets one load-filter-save triple for EVERY flight key in CACHE (departure_flights and return_flights = two triples with the same kwargs); (b) a 'Yes' to an offer of hotels near/close to the cached attractions, with hotels and attractions keys both in CACHE, is `h = get_results_from_cache(key=<most refined hotels key>)`, `a = get_results_from_cache(key=<most refined attractions key>)`, `n = search_nearest(hotels=h, attractions=a, groupBy="hotel")`, `save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels", value=n)`, with no filter and no re-save of the attractions entry.

edits.target: Conversely, when the last message is about hotels or restaurants, write no flight line.
edits.content: Flight times are always 12-hour 'HH:MM AM/PM' strings: 'anytime before 04:39 AM' -> `departure_time=["12:00 AM", "04:39 AM"]`, 'afternoon' -> `["12:00 PM", "5:00 PM"]`; the '00:00:00' style raises 'Unrecognized time format'. Load each leg's MOST REFINED key (filtered_departure_flights beats departure_flights) and pass only the new kwarg; a class already shown in its summary is not passed again.
